release_order.work: Extract only relevant units; audit locators and ISO preview limits; bind evidence to the existing note/question sections; independent release review.
Separate supervisory/model-risk evidence from voluntary AI RMF and Article 50 guidance; review image-warning pages where used; construct only evidence-supported sections and questions.
Audit direct/indirect injection and agent goal-hijack locators; distinguish AI Act-specific material from security guidance; retain current limits and no universal legal claim.
Re-review signing/provenance and supervisory records; revalidate the exact ATLAS CS0027 object and its incident limits; bind only the audited references.

parallelization.allowed: source extraction and bounded fidelity checks may run in parallel by release
parallelization.serialization: evidence lock consolidation, independent review, human approval and deterministic integration remain per-release and sequential
parallelization.do_not: Do not alter config/brain-evaluation.json to mask evidence gaps; do not create placeholder notes or claims.

per_release: all evidence refs resolve with source/unit hashes and locators
target sections have current reviewed evidence
acceptance.benchmark: rerun brain evaluate after each approved integration; preserve 15/15 negative passes; report readiness changes without marking coverage COMPLETE
